Non-interactive unless it is dismissible.; pagination: Moves between pages of content.; select / dropdown: A choice among options. The native <select> does the choosing; the design styles the trigger around it.; helper text: Guidance or a message under a field: hint, error, success. ## Accessibility

WCAG 2.2 AA: `1.3.1`, `2.1.1`, `4.1.2`

- The trigger is a real <button>; aria-expanded is the state, aria-controls the relationship (4.1.2).
- Closed content is hidden from everyone, not only visually (1.3.1).
- Keyboard: Enter/Space toggles; focus stays on the trigger (2.1.1).
